title: The Bitter Lesson Learned from 2,000+ Multilingual Benchmarks

bias_targets.methodology: Correlating LLM performance on 8 multilingual benchmarks with human judgments (Chatbot Arena Elo ratings) across five languages (Chinese, French, German, Spanish, Russian) to assess performance disparities and highlight the limitations of translating English benchmarks into other languages.

Comparing the correlation of LLM performance with local human judgments using machine-translated benchmarks (e.g., translated MMLU) versus culturally localized benchmarks (e.g., CMMLU) to demonstrate the impact of missing cultural nuances and region-specific knowledge.
